name: Elsayed Mustafa
headline: I turn manual work into reliable automation.
intro: Software and AI tools for customers, daily operations and data. Open a project and try it.
about: I build production-oriented tools that replace manual workflows with reliable software. My work combines Python automation, AI and machine learning, browser automation, APIs, PostgreSQL and Supabase, Google Apps Script, and practical web interfaces.
approach: Start with the business workflow and its failure modes, then design the automation around them.
Measure models and strategies on unseen data instead of presenting unverified claims.
Keep credentials server-side, apply least privilege, and make important actions auditable.
Build resumable pipelines that can recover from API limits, timeouts and partial runs.
seeking: Open to AI Automation Engineer, Python Automation Engineer and Applied AI Engineer roles.

skills.title: Business automation
skills.text: Repeated manual steps turned into a system that runs by itself.

skills.title: WhatsApp and Telegram bots
skills.text: Messages that create records, alert your team and wait for an answer.

skills.title: AI in your workflow
skills.text: AI that reads and sorts the work. Code checks it, a person decides.

skills.title: Web scraping and data collection
skills.text: Businesses, contacts and reviews collected from websites into clean tables.

skills.title: Google Sheets reports
skills.text: Reports your team works from, refreshed every day without copy and paste.

skills.title: Databases and APIs
skills.text: Your data in a real database, with an API and alerts on top.

capabilities.title: Model-backed workflows with guardrails
capabilities.summary: Putting a model inside a process without trusting it blindly: rules before the call, checks after it, and a person at the decision.

evidence.text: Every model answer requested as JSON against a schema, then checked again in code
A second, adversarial pass that keeps the lower of two scores
CV tailoring by bullet id, so the model cannot write experience that does not exist

capabilities.title: Business process automation
capabilities.summary: Turning a manual workflow into a system that validates input, keeps one record of truth and notifies the right person.

evidence.text: WhatsApp enquiries become deduplicated leads, bookings and technician notifications
Follow-ups, contracts, inventory and expenses handled in one operational app

capabilities.title: Backend and API engineering
capabilities.summary: Server-side rules, authenticated endpoints and a clear contract between a front-end and its data.

evidence.text: Edge Function API with HMAC-signed, scoped, expiring tokens and per-scope allow-lists
Booking conflict rules enforced on the server, not in the form
A read-only API: every request in a read-only transaction with a statement timeout

capabilities.title: Databases and data migration
capabilities.summary: Modelling operational data in PostgreSQL and moving a live system onto it safely.

evidence.text: 18 tables behind 30 ordered migrations, with dashboards as SQL functions
Domain-by-domain cutover from Google Sheets, each gated by a parity check
A database role that can only select, and a queue claimed with row locks

capabilities.title: Reliability and failure handling
capabilities.summary: Deciding what happens when a dependency is slow, a message arrives twice or a job fails.

evidence.text: A job queue with leases, retries with jitter and dead jobs, checked by breaking it on the running worker
A circuit breaker that skips a failing price provider and tries it again with a single call
Outbox with retry, linear backoff and a failure state after 8 attempts
Reads fall back to a second path; writes are never replayed, to rule out duplicate bookings
Tables used as queues, so a run that stops halfway resumes by itself

capabilities.title: Measurement before belief
capabilities.summary: Testing an idea before anything depends on it: replay on recorded data, checks that catch a lucky sample, and failed ideas kept on record.

evidence.text: Strategies run side by side on the same signals, so rules are compared on identical entries
A sampling bias that made a losing market look profitable, found and fixed in the data loader
Development code that cannot open the sealed holdout data
Synchronous and asynchronous endpoints benchmarked before choosing between them

capabilities.title: Integrations
capabilities.summary: Connecting a system to the services a business already uses.

evidence.text: Green API (WhatsApp), Gmail, Google Contacts and Google Drive
Gemini, Telegram Bot API and eleven job-board sources
